en: Agent Work Shop brings agent teams, production lines, and digital twins into one operational workspace.
This walkthrough follows the application as it is actually configured.
zh: AgentWorkShop 将智能体团队、产线与数字孪生整合到同一个工业工作空间。
本片直接演示当前运行中的产品界面。
enCaption:
AgentWorkShop brings agent teams, production lines,
and digital twins into one operational workspace.

This walkthrough follows the application
as it is actually configured.

en: A reusable scenario assembles the roles around a job and gives a new workspace a clear structure.
zh: 可复用场景会按任务装配团队角色，为新工作区提供清晰结构。
enCaption:
A reusable scenario assembles the roles
around a job and gives a new workspace structure.

en: Here, a lead, process engineer, and analyst share one channel.
Team status, tasks, and line operations stay visible beside the event timeline.
zh: 这里，负责人、工艺工程师和数据分析师共享同一个频道。
团队状态、任务与产线操作都与事件时间线并列呈现。
enCaption:
Here, a lead, process engineer,
and analyst share one channel.

Team status, tasks, and line operations stay
visible beside the event timeline.

en: Each production line keeps its own nodes, products, recipes, and acquisition context.
Before a run begins, operators can inspect the configuration in one place.
zh: 每条产线分别管理节点、产品、配方和采集上下文。
启动运行前，操作人员可以在同一页面检查完整配置。
enCaption:
Each production line keeps its own nodes,
products, recipes, and acquisition context.

Before a run begins, operators can inspect
the configuration in one place.

en: This line has one control node, one product, and one recipe.
Its status is standby, and the line remains stopped.
zh: 这条演示产线配置了一个控制节点、一个产品和一个配方。
当前状态为待机，整条产线保持停止。
enCaption: One control node, one product, one recipe.
Status: standby. The line remains stopped.

en: This card identifies the setup as an isolated mock demonstration.
No PLC hardware is connected. We leave Start untouched and send no command.
This walkthrough shows configuration only, with no live factory run.
zh: 这张卡片标明当前配置是隔离的模拟演示。
没有连接真实 PLC；我们没有触碰启动控件，也没有发送任何指令。
本片展示的是配置界面，没有现场生产运行。
enCaption:
No PLC hardware is connected. Start stays untouched;
no control command is sent.
Configuration walkthrough; no live factory run.
